case_name: Smt Sanju D/O Shri Chunni Lal,W/O-Shri ... vs State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Sanju D/o Shri Chunni Lal,w/o-Shri Baldev Saini, and Baldev Saini S/o Shri Mula Ram Saini
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Rajasthan, Through Principal Secretary, Home Department, Secretariat, Jaipur, Superintendent Of Police, Jhunjhunu, Raj., S.H.O, Police Station, Udaipurwati, District-Jhunjhunu, and Shri Chunni Lal,s/o-Shri Rameshwar Lal

facts_of_case: Petitioners have preferred this Criminal Miscellaneous Petition seeking protection of life and liberty. Certificate of registration of marriage is annexed with the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The court cannot perpetuate illegality by giving protection to the petitioners.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that the marriage performed by petitioners being in contravention of Sub Clause (IV) of Clause II of Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act, the same is punishable under Clause (B) of Section 18 of the Hindu Marriage, hence, Court cannot perpetuate illegality by giving protection to the petitioners.

legal_principles.principle: The court cannot grant protection to petitioners who fall within the prohibited degrees under the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that petitioners falls within the prohibited degrees under Sub Clause (IV) of Clause II of Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The marriage is void, hence, the Court cannot grant protection to the petitioners.

outcome.final_order: The Court cannot grant protection to the petitioners as they fall within prohibited degrees under Sub Clause (IV) of Clause II of Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

use_for_drafting: appealing a stay order in a family court
